title: Mu Chen vs Xue Shi
summary: Mu Chen, fresh from the infusion, returns to the arena, sees Luo Li hurt, and challenges Xue Shi, whom he recognises as middle-phase Heavenly Completion. Xue Shi uses Blood Shadow Killing Formation, Blood River to Heaven and the Blood Divine Armor, and his blood qi drains his opponent's spiritual power; the Supreme Cauldron side cannot believe Mu Chen is only at late Heavenly Transformation. Mu Chen breaks the armor from inside and out with the new Constellation Sutra of Four Gods and the Lightning Fist, knocking Xue Shi out of bounds. When Xue Shi attacks his back, Mu Chen hits him with Dark God Thunder poison; Fei Qingsong steps in, Tai Cang faces him down, and Supreme Cauldron leaves vowing revenge at the Spiritual Academy Competition. Mu Chen is hailed as third on the Heavenly Ranking. Tai Cang warns of stronger rivals such as Ji Xuan, who appears briefly, while Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong keep chasing Mo Longzi.
events: Mu Chen returns and challenges Xue Shi.

cultivation: Mu Chen: Heavenly Transformation, Late Phase, after the infusion ('he has made another breakthrough'). Xue Shi confirmed at middle Heavenly Completion.
